result.summary: The landlord said yes, but only to Harlow Heating and only up to £150. Neither condition can be met: Harlow is booked until 3 November, unless they do an emergency visit at double rate. Quick Fix Heating can come on Monday 6 October but quoted £230, which is not Harlow and is over the cap. I booked no one and emailed the landlord the three options to choose from. I also emailed the tenant an update with a safe valve and bleeding check, and asked whether anyone in the home is vulnerable. The case is on hold with a follow-up in 1 day.
result.situation: Only the bedroom radiator at 27 Thistle Lane is cold; the rest of the house heats normally. The landlord approved Harlow only, max £150 (event 003). Harlow is booked until 3 Nov and charges double for an emergency visit (event 004). Quick Fix offered Mon 6 Oct at £230 including parts (event 005). The CRM had no approval record and the ticket was still at intake.
